title: Comfy, durable, but has its issues that are concerning
text: Comfy, durable, but has its issues that are concerning. The bars that hold your cover tight and basically mimic buttons eventually fall through the holes and then your covers super loose. This is from general couch use not as a bed.  The cushion is 10x better for sitting on than your cushion that comes with the futon. Its roughly 4x thicker and has springs comfort wise is say 8/10. Its not terrible for the price and if your using it as a couch futon in a dorm id def say you should upgrade. But just be aware the parts above mentioned will eventually fall into the mattress and you will have those holes showing that could potentially rip bigger down the road.  The cover is also not washable so id recommend a cover to keep it clean.

product_metadata.title: DHP 8 Inch Independently Encased Coil Futon Mattress, Black Microfiber
features: Independently, superbly pocketed 15-gauge pocket coils that help provide equal weight distribution by contouring to the curves of your body and relieving pressure points along your neck, shoulders, back and hips.
Quality foam and polyester layering between cover and coils for optimal comfort. Microfiber mattress cover.
Fits any standard full-size futon frame (sold separately).

Foam in this mattress is made without PBDEs, TDCPP or TCEP (“Tris”) flame retardants, ozone depleters, mercury, lead and heavy metals. Meets federal flammability standard 16 CFR 1633. Foam is low in VOC emissions for indoor air quality (less than 0.5 PPM). Made without phthalates regulated by the Consumer Safety Product Commission
Mattress dimensions: 75"L x 54"W x 8"H. Net weight: 59 lbs. Shipping dimensions: 59"L x 13"W x 13"H. Gross weight: 71 lbs.
description: Get ultimate comfort with DHP's 8-inch Independently Encased Coil Futon Mattress. This mattress will have you dreaming for days with its superior construction. Made with a base of independently encased coils, it provides equal weight distribution by contouring to the curves of your body and relieving pressure points along your neck, shoulders, back and hips. Each coil works independently of the others, only reacting to the pressure that is directly applied to the particular spring, resulting in greater comfort and support and reduced motion transfer. This futon mattress is topped with high-density foam, which provides exceptionally comfortable surface and best of all, it fits any standard full futon frame. The futon mattress is upholstered in a soft microfiber fabric with tufting details to provide the perfect finishing touches on an already great mattress. Available in multiple color options, there is a DHP 8 Inch Independently Encased Coil Futon Mattress that will best suit and complement your favorite futon frame, style and décor!
